items.title: Vitamin D supplementation does not reduce fracture risk in community-dwelling adults
items.why: Stop supplementing for bone health unless you are deficient or over 70.

items.title: Ground cinnamon recalled across twelve states for elevated lead
items.why: Check the lot code on the tin; return it to the store for a refund.

items.title: Spaced retrieval outperforms rereading in a 4,000-student trial
items.why: Close the book and self-test; rereading feels productive and is not.

items.title: Chrome ships system-wide live captions for any audio in any tab
items.why: Enable under Settings, Accessibility; works offline and on any video.

items.title: Blood pressure targets below 120 systolic reduce events in adults over 60
items.why: Worth asking your doctor whether your current target is out of date.

items.title: Front-loading rear child seats recalled for harness release defect
items.why: Affected models release under load; free replacement harness from the maker.
